mapper.select: select count(*) from yh_health_lecture_watch t1,yh_health_lecture_info t2 where t1.class_id = t2.infoId and t1.class_id= #{classId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select t1.user_code,t3.name,t3.mobile,t1.age,t1.org_name,t1.watch_date,t1.end_time,t1.status,t2.title,t2.typeid from yh_health_lecture_watch t1 inner join yh_health_lecture_info t2 on t1.class_id = t2.infoId inner join yh_user_reginfo t3 on t1.user_code = t3.user_code where t1.watch_date BETWEEN CONCAT(CURDATE(),' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(CURDATE(),' 23:59:59')

select t1.*,t2.title as headline,t2.typeid,t3.user_code,t3.name,t3.mobile from yh_health_lecture_watch t1 inner join yh_health_lecture_info t2 on t1.class_id = t2.infoId inner join yh_user_reginfo t3 on t1.user_code = t3.user_code where t2.infoId=#{infoid} and t2.category_id=#{categoryId}

select t1.user_code,t3.name,t3.mobile,t1.age,t1.org_name,t1.watch_date,t1.end_time,t1.status,t2.title,t2.typeid from yh_health_lecture_watch t1 inner join yh_health_lecture_info t2 on t1.class_id = t2.infoId inner join yh_user_reginfo t3 on t1.user_code = t3.user_code WHERE TO_DAYS( NOW( ) ) - TO_DAYS( t1.watch_date) = 1

select t1.user_code,t3.name,t3.mobile,t1.age,t1.org_name,t1.watch_date,t1.end_time,t1.status,t2.title,t2.typeid from yh_health_lecture_watch t1 inner join yh_health_lecture_info t2 on t1.class_id = t2.infoId inner join yh_user_reginfo t3 on t1.user_code = t3.user_code WHERE YEARWEEK( date_format(t1.watch_date,'%Y-%m-%d' ) ) = YEARWEEK( now())

select t1.user_code,t3.name,t3.mobile,t1.age,t1.org_name,t1.watch_date,t1.end_time,t1.status,t2.title,t2.typeid from yh_health_lecture_watch t1 inner join yh_health_lecture_info t2 on t1.class_id = t2.infoId inner join yh_user_reginfo t3 on t1.user_code = t3.user_code WHERE YEARWEEK(date_format(t1.watch_date,'%Y-%m-%d')) = YEARWEEK(now())-1;
